svg.title: Tendyne - orthographic oblique - original illustrative schematic
svg.desc: Tendyne original PMA | representative standard-profile implant and apical pad. Distal +Z: left ventricular outflow; -Z: left atrial inflow; +X: anterior cuff side. Fixed orthographic projection. Original parametric geometry; mesh, proportions and repeated features simplified. Not to scale. Technical review only; human signoff pending. See SOURCES.md.
